academic_requirements: An Italian bachelor's, specialist/master's, or old-system 4-, 5-, or 6-year degree, or an equivalent foreign qualification.
Graduates of the Materials Science degree class under DM 146 of 2 September 2021 automatically satisfy the curricular requirements.
Other applicants must document at least 10 ECTS in chemistry, 10 ECTS in physics, and 10 ECTS in mathematics.
Applicants must pass an assessment of curricular requirements and personal preparation.
qualification_system_requirements: For a foreign master's-entry qualification: at least 15 total years of education, including at least three years at university level, and entitlement to enter a second-cycle degree in the country where the qualification was issued.
The Programme Committee or academic board determines whether a foreign qualification is suitable after the pre-enrolment request.
eligible_degree_classes: Materials Science degree class established by DM 146 of 2 September 2021
Other Italian degrees or equivalent foreign qualifications meeting the specified chemistry, physics, and mathematics credit requirements
language_requirements: English proficiency at CEFR B2 or equivalent is required.
Ability to understand and use English in scientific contexts is assessed in the preliminary interview.
accepted_language_evidence: Preliminary interview assessment by the Programme Committee
personal_preparation_assessment: Applicants submit an interview request giving qualifications, chemistry/physics/mathematics credits, relevant experience, and English and Italian proficiency. The Programme Committee conducts an interview, which may be by teleconference; admission depends on its outcome.
ofa_or_remedial_obligations: The committee may identify a need to supplement prior knowledge after the interview; precise conditions are not stated [uncertain].

interview_details.purpose: Verification of admission requirements, scientific preparation, curricular fit, and English proficiency
interview_details.dates: Scheduled by the examining committee and programme coordinator after the request [uncertain]
